name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalized_optimality
type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Simple),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 ≤ p.Lminus →
        0 ≤ p.Lpm →
          0 < max p.Lminus p.Lpm →
            ↑p.n ≤ √↑p.m →
              ∀ (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                Monotone τ →
                  ∀ (S : ℕ),
                    0 < S →
                      ∀ (ρ : ℝ),
                        0 < ρ →
                          ρ ≤ 1 →
                            outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient
                                (outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalizedInput p τ)
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleBatch p)
                                (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.simpleProbability p) ≤
                              20 *
                                outputs.Proofs.FreyaParameterTuning.timeCoefficient
                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.normalizedInput p τ) S ρ
